items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: My dad was an ice cream business.

ctx.x: Uh... Whatever you... Wherever you want to start telling about your life. You know, did you come from a musical family? No. Nobody played music in front of you?
No. They all were hardworking folks. I mean, ice cream business. My dad was an ice cream business.
Well, that gave you an opportunity to hear a little music, I guess, huh?
